headers.comment: The Guild is one HTML file, so a cached copy of it is a cached copy of the whole application. Safari on iOS holds onto such a file hard, which meant a deployed fix could sit on the server for an hour while the phone kept running the old code. These pages must be revalidated on every visit; they are small, and correctness matters more than the few kilobytes.
The Lineage images never change once named, so they may be held for a year.
